lines.atf: _DISZ sze_ ina _ugu sag-du lu2 gar szu {d}iszkur nu kala zarah2 dib_-su#
lines.english: If a barley is located on the head of a man: hand of Adad, he will not reach the highest rank.

lines.atf: _DISZ sze_ ina _sag-du na_ lu ina 1(u) 5(disz) lu ina 2(gesz2) 3(u) _gar na bi ti-la_ la pa-<sza2>-ha _igi_-mar

If a barley in the head of a man

lines.english: If there is a mole on the top of the na na-gauge, there will be a favorable heart for it.

lines.atf: _DISZ sze_ ina _sa gu2 na gar sza3-bi du10-ga_
lines.english: If a barley is located on the neck of a man's neck: his heart will be happy.
If a barley in his temple is 15: he will raise a dais.
If the barley in his temple is 190, he will recover.
If there is a mole on his head: hand of ama will come out in the paphal of a strong woman.

lines.atf: _DISZ sze_ ina _sag-ki_-szu2 1(u) 5(disz) _gar_ at-mu-szu2 _ugu dingir_ u _lugal du10-ga_ i-szar2-ru3

If the barley in the back of its neck is not present; all day

lines.atf: _DISZ sze_ ina _sur_-szu2 1(u) 5(disz) _gar dingir_ ana _na arhusz tuku_-szi
lines.english: If there is a mole on his right thighs: the god will have mercy on him.
